token_set.name: The Completion Cup (Award)
token_set.description: The Completion Cup contains all the Heroic highlights that served as rewards for completing sets and Legend of the Completion Cup Quests within NHL Breakaway Series 3 collection. From past legends to present stars, this exclusive set brims with great players, impactful highlights, and remarkable achievements.

description:
Sergei Fedorov’s brilliance was on full display December 26, 1996, when he single-handedly carried Detroit to victory by scoring all five goals in a thrilling 5–4 overtime win against Washington. It was a jaw-dropping showcase of everything that made him special—blazing speed through the neutral zone, a lethal wrist shot, and the ability to rise in the biggest moments. Fedorov was unstoppable, delivering one of the most legendary individual performances in Red Wings history.  
A true two-way superstar, Fedorov became the first Russian-born Hart Trophy winner (1994) and twice claimed the Selke as the NHL’s best defensive forward. He helped power Detroit to three Stanley Cups (1997, 1998, 2002) and was the first Russian player to record 1,000 career points. Inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame in 2015, Fedorov remains one of the most complete players the game has ever seen.
